ai_meme.description: Have Imgflip's AI write a meme from scratch, on a topic if you give one, on a template you choose or one it picks. The openai model is the default; the classic model learnt from unfiltered public memes and can be crude. Needs API Premium: the first 50 a month are included, then two cents each.
ai_meme.display_str_template: Make an Imgflip meme with AI.

texts: Using a complicated app to remember passwords
Typing them in the Notes app and naming it "definitely_not_passwords"

ai_meme.name: ai_meme

parameters.description: Which AI writes the meme. The classic model is Imgflip's own, trained on public memes without filtering.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Optional: the template to write on, as its ID, a link or a template an earlier step returned. The openai model takes any popular template; the classic model one of the 48 at imgflip.com/ai-meme. Left empty, Imgflip picks one.
parameters.name: template

parameters.description: Optional, up to 64 characters. For the openai model, the meme's topic, such as 'Monday mornings'. For the classic model, the words the meme must start with; shorter gives it more room.
parameters.name: prefix_text

parameters.description: Leave Imgflip's small watermark off the meme. Needs API Premium: the first 100 a month are included, then a cent each.
parameters.name: remove_watermark

parameters.description: Optional: what the watermark says. A free account may choose 'imgflip.com' or 'made at imgflip.com'; any other text needs API Premium and counts like removing the watermark.
parameters.name: watermark_text

parameters.description: Optional: which corner the watermark goes in, or huge across the middle.
parameters.name: watermark_position

parameters.description: Download the finished meme and keep it as a file, to attach to an email or a message in a later step. The meme's url works on its own wherever a link will do.

caption_image.description: Write text on an Imgflip meme template and get the finished meme's link. A top and bottom text makes a classic meme in capitals; text boxes handle templates with more boxes, or place and colour the text. The font, size and watermark can be set, and the meme can be kept as a file. Free, with Imgflip's watermark.

description: Make memes with Imgflip: caption the templates people use most or any template on the site, with the classic top and bottom text or boxes you place yourself, and keep the finished meme as a link or a file.
